summary: End-to-end testing of the new /get-in-touch page (backend + frontend) plus regression on /contact and other public pages. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass against POST /api/contact-enquiries (valid submission returns 200 with id, whitespace-only firstName -> 422, invalid email -> 422, message >1500 chars -> 422, duplicate within 1 min -> 409, GET denied -> 405). Frontend: page loads at /get-in-touch with correct title 'Get in Touch | BluBridge', hero (eyebrow/heading/lede) + 4 help cards + form card all visible. Business Enquiries card scrolls to form, Partnerships navigates to /partners, Careers navigates to /careers, Support card exposes mailto:info@blubridge.com. Empty submit shows red errors under all 6 required fields; filling firstName clears only its own error and preserves other user input. Verify Email button: invalid email shows error, valid email flips button to green 'Verified ✓'. Char counter updates ('11 / 1500') and maxLength truncates at 1500. Full UI submission with unique email succeeds -> button shows 'Sending…' and is disabled, then success banner appears, form resets, URL stays on /get-in-touch. Immediate duplicate submit shows the 409 friendly error. Mobile 390x844: page stacks (cards top=537 < form top=1456), no true horizontal overflow (docWidth==innerWidth==390; flagged elements are the off-canvas closed mobile drawer). Tablet 1024: docWidth==1024, clean. Regression /contact still submits (form clears after Submit) and title unchanged; /, /solutions, /research, /about-us, /careers all return 200 with unchanged titles.
critical_code_review_comments: GetInTouch.jsx: clean use of controlled inputs + per-field error clearing on change. Consider adding role='alert'/aria-live to git-success-message and git-submit-error for screen-reader announcements.
server.py ContactEnquiry: field_validator on email (EmailStr) already blocks invalid formats; the explicit validate_email(enquiry.email) 400 branch inside the route is unreachable and can be removed.

Duplicate check compares stored ISO string 'createdAt' with an ISO string threshold — works only because both are UTC-Z ISO with the same offset; safer to store as datetime and query with a datetime object.
Rate limiter (429) is aggressive enough to affect back-to-back automated tests; test suite adds a sleep before the 1501-char case to work around it — worth documenting for future testers.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of contact_enquiries MongoDB docs via the endpoint using unique qa.api.* and qa.git.ui.* emails (expected per instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/contact-enquiries is whitelisted in SecurityMiddleware.PUBLIC_POST_PATHS. Duplicate window = 1 minute per lowercased email. GET on that path is 405 (only POST defined). SecurityMiddleware rate limiter can return 429 on rapid repeat POSTs — add ~15s sleep between negative tests when batching. Frontend testids all present as documented; use data-testid selectors. Preview URL: https://brush-reveal-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com.
